_comment: The playable card pool. Lifted out of demo.js. `type` is the Slay the Spire card band — attack advances the room, skill buys information or safety, power changes the rest of the run — and it drives the frame colour in the client. `rooms` is the hand filter: a card is legal when the list is empty or contains the active room's type. `agent_skill` names the dealt .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md that playing this card actually invokes, which is the reality bridge; a card with no agent_skill is played by hand. `progress` is how much of the room's clear_at it advances — not damage.

rarities._comment: Rarity encodes how broadly a card applies, not how good it is. ENTITY_STANDARDS.md: a card legal everywhere and always correct is a relic filed wrong.

cards.title: Failing Test First
cards.body: Pin the defect with a red test.

cards.title: Characterization
cards.body: Lock current behaviour in a test.

cards.title: Record Decision
cards.body: Write the call and the spike outcome.

cards.title: Small Diff
cards.body: Cut the change to one reviewable unit.

cards.title: Runbook
cards.body: Write down how to operate it.

cards.title: Run Tests
cards.body: Run the suite and read the first failure, not the last.

cards.title: Orient
cards.body: Read before writing. Name the files this room touches.

cards.title: Cut Scope
cards.body: Remove a requirement and say so out loud.

cards.title: Bisect
cards.body: Find the commit that broke it instead of guessing.

cards.title: Narrow the Signature
cards.body: Delete an optional argument and migrate every caller.

cards.title: Minimal Repro
cards.body: Shrink the failing case until nothing can be removed.

cards.title: Test Harness
cards.body: For the rest of this act, bug rooms need one less progress to clear.

cards.title: Write the ADR
cards.body: Record the decision, the alternatives, and the date.

cards.title: Flee with Notes
cards.body: Leave the room, but write down what you learned first.
